notes.title: Update notes for Jun 2
notes.notes: Hey everyone, I'm excited to share some updates about Drone Adventure! The latest version includes some exciting upgrades that I think you're going to love. One of the key additions is the implementation of (x ** 1/3) * 3 to most controls, which has really enhanced the overall experience. Now, you can also customize your in-game settings to control where you'd like your throttle to start – whether it's at the center or at the bottom of the axis. These upgrades have taken the gameplay to a whole new level, providing users with more control and an even more immersive experience. I can't wait for you to try it out and experience the difference for yourself. Stay tuned for more updates and happy flying!

notes.title: Drone Adventure: Latest Updates and Enhancements!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I'm excited to share some of the latest updates we've made to Drone Adventure! We've been hard at work improving the game and adding new features to make your gaming experience even better. Here's a rundown of what's new: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019717/734c63fb1931c800cbedae2d7b378ed70fafd7da.png[/img]

City Bug Fixes: We've addressed several bugs and glitches in the city level to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience. The spawn points have been fixed, and the city now has an official center, defined by a 3D node. 

Balloon and UFO Effects: Get ready for some visually stunning action! We've added eye-catching effects for balloons and UFOs in the game, making the gameplay more immersive and exciting. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019717/41976b12d46a883bca6ac076f908623ad9591be0.png[/img]

Tuned Gun and NPC Weights: We've fine-tuned the gun mechanics and NPC weights to enhance the overall balance and feel of the game. You'll notice improved weapon handling and more challenging non-player characters. 

Reset Game Feature: You can now reset the game without leaving the game itself. 
Auto-Hide Mouse: Say goodbye to distractions! 

Boss Life Bar: We've added a life bar for the boss, giving you a clear indication of your progress in defeating this powerful adversary.

Credit Screen: We've added a credit screen to give recognition to all the talented individuals who have contributed to the development of open-source assets used in Drone Adventure. 

We hope you enjoy the latest improvements to Drone Adventure, and we can't wait to hear your feedback. Happy gaming!

notes.title: Immersive Music Integration in Drone Adventure: Shaping the Player's Experience
notes.notes: Hey everyone,  I'm excited to share some insights about the process of adding music to our latest game, Drone Adventure. One of the key elements we focused on was creating themed music for different locations within the game. The shop, surface, and the city all have their own unique soundtracks, adding depth and immersion to the gameplay experience.  In addition to location-specific music, we wanted to incorporate dynamic elements into the game's audio. For example, when players ascend to higher altitudes, they'll encounter more intense and dramatic music, signaling the presence of gigantic UFOs. This not only adds an element of surprise and excitement but also enhances the overall thrill of the gameplay.  We believe that music plays a crucial role in shaping the player's emotional connection to the game world, and we've strived to create a soundtrack that complements the adventurous and otherworldly nature of Drone Adventure.  Stay tuned for more updates, and don't forget to turn up the volume for the ultimate Drone Adventure experience!

notes.title: May 14th Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hey there! Today I want to talk about an exciting new game feature that's got everyone buzzing - the latest update for Drone Adventure! This update promises to take the game to a whole new level with bug fixes, the introduction of more UFOs the deeper you go, and the spawning of better and better crystals underground. But that's not all - players can also expect to see crystals appearing in blimps, adding a whole new dimension to the game. It's safe to say that fans of Drone Adventure have a lot to look forward to with this update. So, get ready to dive in and experience the thrill of uncovering valuable crystals while navigating through an increasingly challenging UFO-filled environment. Happy gaming!
